interpolate_intrinsics: interpolate camera intrinsics between two frame dictionaries using a linear alpha parameter
interpolate_extrinsics: interpolate camera extrinsics 4x4 matrices between two poses using SLERP for rotation
convert_camera_coeffs_to_pinhole_matrix: convert NeRFStudio camera intrinsics to a 3x3 pinhole camera matrix as torch or numpy
gl2cv: convert camera poses from OpenGL to OpenCV coordinate system with optional conversion matrix return
intrinsics_to_fov: compute horizontal and vertical fields of view in radians from camera focal lengths and image dimensions
